title: Renaissanceschloss Tratzberg Stans
highlights: One of the best preserved and most opulent Renaissance palaces in Europe
Unbroken Late Gothic and Renaissance interior state featuring master craftsmanship woodwork
Legendary Habsburg Hall decorated with a spectacular 46-meter painted genealogical mural
Engaging radio-play audio tour and charming Tratzberg Express shuttle mini-train
kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Tratzberg between Stans and Jenbach is an outstanding Renaissance jewel boasting fully preserved original furnishings.
beschreibung:
Renaissance Masterpiece in the Inntal

Perched high above the Unterinntal between Stans and Jenbach, Schloss Tratzberg was built around 1500 by the brothers Veit-Jakob und Simon Tänzl. It is considered one of the best-preserved and most significant Renaissance architectural monuments in the entire German-speaking world.

Journey into the Era of Kaiser Maximilian

During an entertaining audio play tour, visitors immerse themselves in the world of emperors, knights, and the Fugger merchant dynasty. Highlights of the visit include the elaborately panelled Habsburger-Saal, the late-Gothic Fuggerstube, the Königszimmer, and the Rüstkammer featuring authentic 16th-century armour and weapons.
